package argojob

import("encoding/json";"os";"path/filepath";"testing")

func TestExportWIFControllerInputs(t *testing.T) {
 dir:=os.Getenv("OBERTH_WIF_PROOF_DIR");if dir=="" {t.Fatal("proof output directory required")}
 for _,shape:=range wifControllerShapes {
  c,r:=wifControllerInput(t,shape);wf,err:=Build(c,r);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  b,err:=json.MarshalIndent(wf,"","  ");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,shape+"-workflow.json"),b,0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 }
}
